description: What the people in a performer's, party's or venue's space can do there.

capability.description: One thing someone can do for a performer, party or venue. page.edit: edit its page. people.manage: add, change and remove its people. listing.request: ask staff to list it in the directory. presskits.manage: edit its press kits and decide who sees them. bookings.answer: answer booking inquiries. shows.manage: announce its shows. events.manage: run its events. bookings.send: send booking inquiries for it. guests.manage: approve guests, run the waitlist and message guests. guests.checkin: check guests in at the door. venue.approve: approve events that name the venue. venue.block: block profiles, acts and parties from naming the venue.

role.description: A named starting set of capabilities. Performers have members and managers, parties have hosts, cohosts and door staff, and venues have owners and bookers.

capabilities.description: Everything someone can do, in full: their role's capabilities with any changes made for them since.
